The '''Epsi Zenith system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Epsi Collective/Legends|Epsi Collective]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Epsi Zenith system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square M-15.<ref name="EAOC" /> In real-world [[Wikipedia:Astronomy|astronomy]], the [[Wikipedia:Zenith|zenith]] is the point on the [[Wikipedia:Celestial sphere|celestial sphere]] that is directly above the observer and is the opposite of the [[Wikipedia:Nadir|nadir]], or the point directly below the observer.<ref name="Zenith">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/zenith-astronomy|text=Zenith &#124; Celestial Point, Celestial Sphere & Celestial Coordinates|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2011-06-21|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20251107185209}}</ref>
